{{Quote|Our Adarian-style donuts are made fresh daily by a genuine Crisp-E-O donut droid. Bright and early every morning, our Crisp-E-O unit sorts through its database of more than 2,400 donut recipes to choose the delicious varieties to be made that day using its internal oil fryer. You never know when you'll discover a new favorite. (If you get the chance, be sure to try the dianoga cream-filled donut--it's divine!)|Dex's Diner menu, on its donuts|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Dianoga cream''' was a type of [[Cream/Legends|cream]]<ref name="Menu" /> that shared its name with the [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]], large [[Limb/Legends|tenticled]] [[Mollusk/Legends|mollusks]].<ref name="Wildlife guide">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> The [[Crisp-E-O donut droid]] that worked at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] had a recipe for [[dianoga cream-filled donut]]s in its database of over 2,400 [[Doughnut/Legends|donut]] recipes. Every [[Local day/Legends|day]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] would choose a selection of its recipes to serve at the [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]]. In the diner's menu, its [[Chef/Legends|chef]], the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], strongly recommended that customer's try the dianoga cream-filled donuts if they have the chance.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dianoga cream was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
